Caller consumes the result as a scalar at decompiled/main/main_0086.c:11825-11829. Exact meanings of the status and helper codes are unknown.

The body zero-initializes a 32-bit output, reads attribute-context status selectors 2 and 1, and passes those results through stripped helpers before conditionally storing a low-bit boolean to the output pointer (decompiled/main/main_0052.c:54033-54062). No indexed caller exists, and the helper semantics are unresolved, so the output predicate cannot be named reliably.

The body obtains a value through stripped helper f_700181a6fc from a global pointer at 0x700227e6c0 with argument 0xd06; it also reads attribute-context selector 0x13 and conditionally writes that value through the global slot at 0x700228a7e8 (decompiled/main/main_0085.c:29753-29775). No indexed caller is available, and the helper/value semantics do not establish the slot's purpose.

Requires a non-null second argument, optionally obtains the associated pointer via f_700183f6e4, then reads player-attribute selector 0x11 using player_attribute_get_float and converts it to a signed integer (decompiled/main/main_0112.c:48375-48406). It returns threshold codes 10..1 for values above 99,89,79,69,59,49,39,29,19,9 respectively, otherwise 0; null input returns -2 (decompiled/main/main_0112.c:48409-48414,48415-48458).
